title: Fanbook
summary: The Fanbooks (officially called Fanbuks in Italy) are a series of small booklets included with some of the 2011 Titan Miniatures produced by Giochi Preziosi. There were twelve Titan Fanbooks to collect in total, and were only available in Italy (six of the figures being Italian exclusives). Each Titan Fanbook would contain a biography about the Titan, promotional artwork and a story about a legend from around the world.
